title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Starting Date of the Limitation Period for the Insurer Under a Marine Insurance Contract to Exercise the Right of Subrogation

articles.content_en:
December 25, 2014
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Commencement Date of the Limitation of Action for the Exercise by the Insurer of the Right to Subrogation for Compensation under a Marine Insurance Contract
Fa Shi [2014] No. 15
Shanghai Higher People's Court:
Your Request for Guidance on Relevant Legal Issues concerning the Commencement Date of the Limitation of Action for the Insurer's Subrogation in Maritime Litigation (Hu Gao Fa [2014] No. 89) has been received. Upon deliberation, the reply is as follows:
In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Maritime Code of the People's Republic of China and the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Trial of Marine Insurance Dispute Cases regarding the exercise by the insurer of the right to subrogation for compensation, and in light of maritime adjudication practice, the commencement date of the limitation of action for the exercise by the insurer of the right to subrogation for compensation under a marine insurance contract shall be determined in accordance with the commencement date of the limitation of action for the relevant claim specified in Chapter 13 of the Maritime Code of the People's Republic of China.
This reply is given.
